name: EmbodiedScan
summary: 面向具身智能整体三维场景理解的多模态第一人称数据集与基准，结合大规模 RGB-D 视图、语言提示、三维框和稠密语义占据标注。
summaryEn: A multimodal egocentric dataset and benchmark for holistic embodied 3D scene understanding, combining RGB-D views, language prompts, oriented 3D boxes, and dense semantic occupancy.
scale: 5K+ scans · 1M RGB-D views · 1M prompts · 160K 3D boxes · 760+ categories
scaleZh: 5000 余个扫描 · 100 万 RGB-D 视图 · 100 万提示 · 16 万个三维框 · 760 余类
organizationsZh: 上海人工智能实验室及合作团队
license: Code and annotations follow official terms; source scans retain their licenses
licenseZh: 代码和标注适用官方条款；源扫描保留各自许可
access: Official code, annotations, and benchmark resources available
accessZh: 提供官方代码、标注和基准资源
verdict: 第一人称多模态三维感知
wmNote: 将局部第一人称观测聚合为语言关联的三维状态，适合空间世界表征；主要是感知数据，不包含丰富动作后果。
wmNoteEn: It supports aggregating local egocentric observations into language-grounded 3D states, but focuses on perception rather than rich action consequences.
